verdict.rationale: Zep explicitly supports single-call retrieval of a ready-to-use context block: scope="auto" composes relevant edges/nodes/episodes/summaries into one block, add_messages() can return the context block directly (return_context=True) eliminating a separate get_user_context() call, and retrieval is sub-200ms. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of a configurable token budget/limit parameter for the returned block, and no independent/hands-on benchmark confirming the token-budgeting behavior.
